gerados.Text: In fatty acid synthesis, the step right after condensation is a {{c1::reduction}} (NADPH), then dehydration, then reduction.
gerados.Extra: NADPH-dependent; mirror of β-oxidation. +2 C per round from malonyl-CoA. Photo credit: Image licensed by Physeo and used with permission.

gerados.Text: Complete oxidation of one palmitate (16 C) yields {{c1::129}} net ATP.
gerados.Extra: 131 gross − 2 (activation). 7 rounds → 8 acetyl-CoA; 31 NADH, 15 FADH2, 8 GTP. Photo credit: Image licensed by Physeo and used with permission.

gerados.Text: Fatty acid activation cleaves ATP to {{c1::AMP + PPi}}, not ADP + Pi (costs ~2 ATP).
gerados.Extra: PPi also split → 2 high-energy bonds (−2 in balance). Enzyme: fatty acyl-CoA synthetase. Photo credit: Image licensed by Physeo and used with permission.
